title: 第15章 提升效率第16章 良弓
content_zh:
问题就是现在他在一级据点里，还找不到高价值的东西。
“要尽快把据点升到二级，但是升级据点的五个条件，还差得很远，首先人数就不达标。”
方南山思索着，升级据点必须要人数达到可容纳值的一半以上，也就是最低五人，并且需要总等级达到三十级，这意味着五人的平均等级要六级，人数多一点，平均等级可以拉低一些。
其二是据点里所有人的总财富值，过十万，不包括已经消费的，必须是身上的钱币总数。第三个条件是总贡献值达到一千。第四个条件是总功勋值达到一万。五是总名望值达到一百。
贡献值主要来源是出售物品给商店，每交易一千元，获得一点贡献值。
另外一些特殊事件，比如杀怪数量达到某个称号的要求，获得了系统公告的称号，会有大量的贡献值功勋值和名望值的奖励。
方南山现在贡献值才一百多，功勋值倒是有九百多了，名望还是十点。
“等击杀一千只骷髅怪的称号奖励吧，不然贡献值还挺难升的。”
卖一万块钱的材料，才十点贡献值，谁顶得住？
“新手据点里第二批降生的人员将会在第一批人员总数少于五成之后的一个星期后降临，明天就是第四天，我还有几天时间单机，必须要尽早确立优势。”
准确的说，明天是他登陆的第四天，但是他第一天就进入单机状态，所以这一个星期的时间是从第二天算起的，也就是他还有五天的单独发育时间。
还是以杀怪为主吧，积攒多一些灵魂碎片。
发展要一步一步来，着急不得，现在变异产物很贵，不是他们这个小家庭能够稳定获取的，他能够把普通物品提升到变异级的产品，并且数量庞大，已经是非常惊人的收获了。
至于把这些变异产品拿出去销售，他是从来没有考虑过的，高风险的事情，他不会轻易涉足。
第二天早上回到学校，仿佛从单机状态又进入了热闹联机网游之中。
方南山无论是在仙界还是在现实，这些天主要的时间，都是自己一个人单机。
但学校里的其他同学，却不一样，每天晚上班级群里热闹极了，各种聊天嬉闹，时刻都在刷屏。
他不想翻看这些没营养的信息，所以一般不参与群里的话题，各种信息有些滞后。
刚进入教室，一阵阵喧闹声仿佛要掀翻天花板，他的座位上也有同学坐下，赵永强正在口沫横飞的吹嘘自己在仙界里的威风战绩。
“灭魔先锋称号的含金量，你们懂不懂？每个据点只有一个人可以获得这个称号，第一个斩杀魔怪达到一百才有，这个称号全属性+2，等于提升两级，吊不吊？我，你们的强哥，昨天就拿到了这个称号，现在哥就一个字：无敌！”

“厉害！”
“强哥无敌！”
同学们欢呼起来，班中有这样的高手，可以加强凝聚力，毕竟都是热血青年，平时没少在操场上跟其他班级的人较量，有赵永强这样的高手坐镇，大家都会更有底气。
连包紫燕等女生，都转头过来，听强哥吹牛。
content_en:
The problem is that he can't find anything of high value in the first-level stronghold.
"We need to upgrade the stronghold to level two as soon as possible, but the five conditions for upgrading the stronghold are still far from being met. First of all, the number of people is not up to standard."
Fang Nanshan thought about it. To upgrade a stronghold, the number of people must reach more than half of the capacity, which is a minimum of five people, and the total level must reach level 30. This means that the average level of the five people must be level 6. The more people there are, the average level can be lowered.
The second is the total wealth value of everyone in the stronghold, which exceeds 100,000, excluding what has been consumed, and must be the total number of coins on the person. The third condition is that the total contribution value reaches one thousand. The fourth condition is that the total merit value reaches 10,000. Fifth, the total reputation value reaches one hundred.
The main source of contribution value is selling items to stores. For every one thousand yuan of transaction, you will get one contribution value.
In addition, for some special events, such as killing monsters to meet the requirements of a certain title, and obtaining a title announced by the system, there will be a large amount of contribution points, merit points and reputation points as rewards.
Fang Nanshan's current contribution value is only over 100, but his merit value is over 900, and his reputation is still 10 points.
"Let's wait for the title reward for killing a thousand skeleton monsters, otherwise it will be difficult to increase the contribution value."
Selling materials for 10,000 yuan only has a contribution value of 10 points. Who can withstand this?
"The second batch of personnel born in the novice stronghold will arrive a week after the total number of personnel in the first batch is less than 50%. Tomorrow is the fourth day. I still have a few days to stand alone, so I must establish my advantage as soon as possible."
To be precise, tomorrow is his fourth day of logging in, but he entered single-player mode on the first day, so this week is calculated from the second day, which means he still has five days of independent development time.
Let's focus on killing monsters and accumulate more soul fragments.
Development must be done step by step, and there is no need to rush. Mutated products are now very expensive and cannot be obtained stably by their small family. He can upgrade ordinary items to mutant-level products in huge quantities, which is already an amazing harvest.
As for selling these mutant products, he has never considered it. He will not get involved easily in high-risk matters.
When I returned to school the next morning, it was as if I had entered a lively online online game from a stand-alone state.
Whether in the fairy world or in reality, Fang Nanshan spends most of his time alone these days.
But the other students in the school are different. The class group is very lively every night, with all kinds of chats and fun, and the screen is always occupied.
He doesn't want to look through such useless information, so he usually doesn't participate in the topics in the group, and various information is lagging behind.
As soon as he entered the classroom, bursts of noise seemed to lift the ceiling. There were also classmates sitting in his seat. Zhao Yongqiang was frothing at the mouth and bragging about his impressive achievements in the fairy world.
"Do you understand the value of the title of Demon Slayer Vanguard? Only one person in each stronghold can obtain this title. The first person to kill 100 monsters can only get this title. This title has all attributes + 2, which is equivalent to a two-level increase. Is it worthy or not? I, your strong brother, got this title yesterday, and now I can only say one word: Invincible!"
"Awesome!"
"Brother Qiang is invincible!"
The students cheered. Having such a master in the class can strengthen cohesion. After all, they are all passionate young people. They usually compete with other classes on the playground. With a master like Zhao Yongqiang in charge, everyone will be more confident.
Even Bao Ziyan and other girls turned around to listen to Brother Qiang bragging.
